head_commit.message:
Enforce errors on overriding built-in model providers (#12024)

We receive bug reports from users who attempt to override one of the
three built-in model providers (openai, ollama, or lmstuio). Currently,
these overrides are silently ignored. This PR makes it an error to
override them.

## Summary
- add validation for `model_providers` so `openai`, `ollama`, and
`lmstudio` keys now produce clear configuration errors instead of being
silently ignored

feat(exec): add --fork option to codex exec

Allow codex exec to fork an existing thread by id while preserving startup session metadata from the fork response.

This refreshes the branch on top of current origin/main, keeps the new exec CLI and tests, and updates the thread-response mapping to the current approvals_reviewer shape used upstream.

head_commit.message:
feat(rollout): preserve fork references across replay

Keep forked and resumed sessions compact by persisting fork references instead of duplicating full parent rollout history.

This refreshes the branch on top of current origin/main, adapts startup restoration to the connector-selection API now used upstream, and updates the affected fork-reference tests to the current function signatures and response item shapes.

feat(rollout): preserve fork references across replay

Keep forked and resumed sessions compact by persisting fork references instead of duplicating full parent rollout history.

This refreshes the branch on top of current origin/main, adapts startup restoration to the connector-selection API now used upstream, and updates the affected fork-reference tests to the current function signatures and response item shapes.

workflow_runs.name: CLA Assistant
workflow_runs.display_title: Semantic codebase indexing and search

head_commit.message:
Enforce errors on overriding built-in model providers (#12024)

We receive bug reports from users who attempt to override one of the
three built-in model providers (openai, ollama, or lmstuio). Currently,
these overrides are silently ignored. This PR makes it an error to
override them.

## Summary
- add validation for `model_providers` so `openai`, `ollama`, and
`lmstudio` keys now produce clear configuration errors instead of being
silently ignored

head_commit.message:
refactor ambiguous bool and option helper APIs

Replace several comment-heavy helper APIs with clearer shapes.
Use named methods for TUI navigation and feature toggles, add
explicit cache and shell startup types, and split default config
loading and input or thread activation helpers into clearer entry
points.

This trims many /*arg=*/ comments from the follow-up branch while
keeping the argument comment lint for one-off literal call sites.
